selection.node_label: unified.qk_norm (QkNormLocalWorklet) [local (1 GPU); qo=num_qo_heads, kv=num_kv_heads, head_dim=head_dim, copy_inputs=false]

r0_measured.definition: selected CostTree node wall fold multiplied by its worker GPU count

r5_hardware_limit.definition: balanced selected-leaf fold of hardware compute/memory limits

r6_segmented_necessary.definition: sum of per-semantic model.work hardware rooflines in the selected scope

r7_scope_fused_necessary.definition: one hardware roofline over selected model.work FLOPs and bytes

omitted_rungs.reason: scheduler idle requires whole-run holding spans
cross-worker load imbalance requires a cluster or pool scope
communication attribution requires the run transfer context
balanced R2 requires sibling worker timing
busy time is a whole-run scheduler measure
batching requires a run-level batch distribution
ignore-network is a whole-run communication counterfactual

provenance.global_rungs: omitted because scheduler and cluster context are undefined for a CostTree subtree

semantic.basis: model.work full-work semantic segments mapped to exact CostTree locations; CostTree Scale is already represented by those segments and is not applied again
